title:
Here’s Nathan our Project Lead, who is now also our IPC, infection prevention and control champion  👑 

All infection prevention and control care champions are expected to attend IPC forums at least three times per year.

The infection prevention and control care champion will support staff on matters concerned with IPC and become a role model initiating best practice in infection prevention and control issues within their working area.

#bluepitshousingaction #socialcare
#ipcchampion
